code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Extend every diagonal same-color segment outward, stopping at other marks.
    for color in colors - {background}:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(pts):
            for r2, c2 in pts[i + 1:]:
                dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
                if abs(dr) == 1 and abs(dc) == 1:
                    for r, c, sr, sc in ((r1-dr, c1-dc, -dr, -dc), (r2+dr, c2+dc, dr, dc)):
                        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and out[r][c] == background:
                            out[r][c] = color
                            r += sr
                            c += sc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
